properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js 1.1.3 ships SHA-1/SHA-2 implementations; it is a dependency of elliptic inside the ethers v5 chain. Library surface only — no call site in the application. SHA-1 is classically collision-broken, but as a shipped hash primitive it carries only Grover's square-root quantum exposure; the D rating matches. Cross-ref LIB-e966a74e (the package object).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA over secp256k1 — the curve Ethereum signs every transaction with. All 8 sites are package-lock.json entries for the secp256k1 implementations shipped by the toolchain (@noble/secp256k1 1.6.3, native secp256k1 4.x, @types/secp256k1), pulled in via @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox. Not merely available: the toolchain actively signs — hardhat wires the env-provided PRIVATE_KEY into network accounts (hardhat.config.js:73,81,89,94) and ethers getSigners()/Wallet signs every deployment and test

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic 6.5.4 is the ECDSA engine inside ethers v5 (@ethersproject/signing-key); it is what signs every hardhat deployment/test transaction, over secp256k1 in this toolchain. Same logical algorithm as ALG-673c8f24 (ECDSA-secp256k1) but a distinct shipped package — kept separate so the dependency inventory records both implementations. Library surface + live toolchain signing path; no application-source call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: SHA-3 implementation inside @noble/hashes 1.1.2 — a second package carrying SHA-3 besides @ethersproject/keccak256 (ALG-052c24b2); kept separate as it is a distinct shipped library. No application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto library shipped with the build: @noble/hashes (dependency of ethereum-cryptography under @nomicfoundation/hardhat-toolbox) provides SHA-256, SHA-3/keccak, BLAKE3, HKDF and PBKDF2 implementations. Available in the shipped library; no direct call site in the application — its algorithms surface through ethers/hardhat internals. The individual algorithm objects (ALG-928ac765, ALG-979eccf8, ALG-c9ef78a4) are its members.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: scrypt-js 2.0.4 — the memory-hard KDF ethers v5 uses to derive keys for encrypted JSON keystores (Wallet encrypt/decrypt). Available in the shipped library; no call site in the application. Cross-ref scout-2's scrypt algorithm object for the same package from the algorithm side.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: sha.js 2.4.11 — pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-224/SHA-256/SHA-384/SHA-512 implementations, in the hardhat/ethers dependency tree. Available in the shipped library; no call site in the application. Hash — Grover only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic 6.5.4 — ECDSA/ECDH implementation; the transaction-signing engine of ethers v5 via @ethersproject/signing-key. The toolchain signs every deploy/tx with it (secp256k1 here). Algorithm-level objects: ALG-710f61f0 (ECDSA) and ALG-673c8f24 (secp256k1). Also exposes ECDH/EdDSA curves it ships, though no application call site uses those.
